optimizedContext.value:
# Workflow Automation
## Rules
- Prefer `--format text` for lifecycle status, transitions, validation to expose blockers/notes. Use machine formats only for structured extraction; prefer `--format toon`, JSON only when unavailable/requested.
- Read surface: `specd specs show <spec-id>` for exact artifact authoring/review; `specd specs context <spec-id>` for semantic context/dependencies/optimization; `specd specs metadata <spec-id>` only normalized projection/materialization diagnostics. Never use metadata as effective config; use project config/status.
- Fetch outline refs on demand with `specd specs outline <specPath> --artifact <artifactId>`; never expect embedded full outlines. Follow command `Next Action` before retry. Use canonical plural groups `changes`, `specs`, `archives`, `drafts`; singular only aliases.
- Skip command only when same-execution prior output provides semantically equivalent fields still fresh at decision boundary. Never assume continuity across skills/sessions; if equivalence uncertain, run explicit command.
- `specd changes validate` proves structure/state only, never semantic approval. Review requirements, constraints, intent before dependent lifecycle progress. After successful individual existing-delta validation, inspect inline diff; if unavailable, use `specd changes spec-preview <change-name> <specId> --diff --artifact <artifactId>`. For broad overlap/drift use full preview; prefer artifact filter for narrow review.
- Every lifecycle skill starts from fresh `change status`; canonical reconciled state, validity projections, blockers, next action govern. Under `workflow: preserve` without required spec-gate recovery, review/correct artifacts in authorized scope and validate new baseline in place; never call structural success semantic review, approval renewal, or verification renewal. Redirect to `specd-design` for authoring, design correction/decision, or required spec-approval recovery. Implement, verify, compliance respect mandatory consent recovery; archive rejects stale/unknown required verification and incomplete live tasks.
- `changes verification invalidate <name> --reason <text>` withdraws completed evidence; explicit `start` creates attempt. Standalone `specd-verify` and `specd-compliance --change <name>` support any active state: status/context → `verification start` → checks/report/hooks → `verification complete` only after success. Completion records skill declaration, not test execution; no `verifying` transition required.
- Full verify starts before scenarios, delegates compliance with `--delegated --attempt <attemptId>`. Delegated compliance neither starts nor completes; still performs full change audit: status/context, specs/direct dependencies, merged `changes spec-preview`, report under change reports, change-scoped filename. All standalone-change downstream branches apply except attempt ownership. Verify completes only after scenarios + audit. Simple verify performs start/checks/complete. Active attempt alone never implies delegation; independent invocation starts own attempt. Non-change compliance emits reports without verification commands.
- Fingerprint change: owning skill inspects cause, explicitly starts again, repeats verification before completion. Never start after tests then complete using old results. Failures/interruption/delegated audit failure never complete. Renewal needs no self-transition or phase re-entry. Skills never calculate fingerprints, invalidate projections, choose recovery targets, or treat `preserve` as forward-progress waiver for unresolved non-task review.
- Maintain traceability with `specd changes implementation add`; tracked files are review surface distinct from confirmed links. Resolve/ignore all before archive; prefer comma-separated `--file`; use integrity review for stale symbols/sidecars.
- When `llmOptimizedContext` enabled, prefer ultra-terse metadata context. Delegate to `specd-project-context-optimizer`/`specd-spec-context-optimizer` when supported; otherwise optimize inline using `skills:agents` smart-caveman style.
## Constraints
- Structural validation never substitutes semantic review or human approval.
- Verification evidence belongs to explicit attempts; only successful current work may complete one.
